statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON / green. Tail is low during scheduled CME maintenance after a record Nasdaq close that still showed meaningful intraday retracement and mixed breadth.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Current Tail remains below the blocking threshold; the next concentrated conditional risk window is September 23 around the U.S. cash open, flash PMI, and the first post-release hour.
headline: Maintenance leaves current Tail low after a two-way record-close session
body: The Nasdaq Composite closed at a second straight record, up 0.45%, while the S&P 500 was flat, oil traded near $100 and the 10-year Treasury yield hovered near 4.94%. CME maintenance removes continuous NQ price discovery in the current hour. Shared Finviz context is stale and partial, so it is excluded from current scoring.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail was mostly low to WATCH, briefly rose to 27% during Tuesday's U.S. cash-session record push, then returned to low as retracement and two-way trade reappeared.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 16% / low during CME maintenance. Overnight risk stays low unless persistent extension returns after the Globex reopen. The next concentrated conditional danger window is September 23, 13:30–15:30 UTC around the cash open, flash PMI and early post-release response.

forecast.analysis: Observed: CME Globex is in its scheduled 17:00–18:00 ET maintenance period. The Nasdaq closed at a second straight record, but Tuesday also showed meaningful intraday retracement and mixed breadth, so current one-way NQ continuation cannot be verified.
drivers: Mixed breadth beneath the index high

forecast.analysis: Conditional: the second post-reopen hour remains low Tail if both advances and retracements develop. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the main escalation signal.
Conditional: the overnight baseline stays low Tail while price discovery remains balanced. A clean directional break that resists meaningful retracement would invalidate the low-Tail case.
Conditional: early Asia remains low Tail absent sustained directional efficiency. Thin liquidity can raise uncertainty, but not Tail by itself.
Conditional: Asia remains low Tail if pullbacks continue to interrupt direction. Consecutive fresh extremes with little retracement would raise risk.
Conditional: late Asia stays low Tail while the market continues to rotate two-way. A sequence of failed retracements would matter more than headline volatility alone.
Conditional: the Asia-Europe handoff remains low Tail unless NQ breaks an overnight extreme and sustains the move without meaningful retracement.
Conditional: early Europe remains low Tail if cross-asset signals stay mixed or price remains two-way. Alignment matters only if NQ also develops persistent direction.
Conditional: as Europe matures, Tail stays low unless a directional move repeatedly survives pullbacks. Oil and yields are secondary amplifiers rather than standalone Tail evidence.
Conditional: the European morning remains low Tail if overnight extremes are not held persistently. Fresh one-way extension would shift the regime toward WATCH.
Conditional: approaching the U.S. premarket, Tail remains low while the overnight structure permits meaningful retracement. A persistent break can lift risk even before the scheduled data window.
Conditional: premarket Tail remains low if price discovery is balanced. The approaching U.S. flash PMI and cash open raise Stress more than Tail until a directional path is actually observed.
Conditional: the final European hour before the main U.S. window stays low Tail absent sustained extension. Divergent semis, megacaps, yields or oil would reduce directional conviction.
Conditional: one hour before the cash open, Tail moves to WATCH because positioning can become more directional. It falls back if pullbacks remain ordinary and no catalyst-aligned trend emerges.
Conditional: the 12:00 UTC hour is a pre-event WATCH window. Stress is high ahead of the cash open and flash PMI, while Tail requires actual one-way structure rather than the calendar alone.

Conditional: the 13:00 UTC hour contains the 13:30 cash open and 13:45 U.S. flash PMI. Elevated Tail requires persistent opening-auction continuation, shallow pullbacks, or failed retracements after the release.
Conditional: the 14:00 UTC hour tests the first post-PMI leg and includes Governor Barr at 14:05 UTC. Tail stays elevated only if the initial move extends and meaningful retracement fails.
Conditional: after the main event cluster, Tail falls to WATCH if price discovery becomes two-way. Continued near-extreme holding with weak retracements would keep risk elevated.
Conditional: mid-session risk eases further if the market absorbs earlier catalysts and retraces normally. Persistent extension would keep WATCH conditions in place.
Conditional: afternoon Tail returns to low if earlier directional pressure fades and cross-asset signals stop reinforcing it. A fresh catalyst-driven leg would reopen WATCH.
Conditional: late afternoon remains low Tail if NQ rotates away from session extremes. Repeated re-tests of the extreme without pullback depth would raise risk.
Conditional: U.S. power hour moves to WATCH because persistent late-session continuation can re-emerge. The score falls if price remains two-way and prior extremes are not held.
Conditional: into the cash close, WATCH reflects the possibility of a late directional squeeze. A balanced close with normal retracement would leave the next maintenance period low Tail.

forecastDetail.comment: Current hour: CME maintenance interrupts NQ price discovery; the record Nasdaq close is context, not current one-way evidence.
Globex reopen remains low Tail unless prior extremes are reclaimed with shallow or failed pullbacks.
The second post-reopen hour stays low Tail if advances and retracements remain two-way.
Overnight risk remains low while a range forms and directional breaks do not resist retracement.
Early-Asia thin liquidity raises uncertainty more than Tail absent sustained directional efficiency.
Asia remains low Tail if pullbacks keep interrupting direction; repeated fresh extremes would be the escalation signal.
